items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Joe LaBarbera with me. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Soon-to-be, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Joe LaBarbera with me. I’ll introduce you as a drummer, composer, jazz educator, and author.
Soon-to-be. Well we’re going to talk about that. I see it looks like you’ve survived the Covid time intact. How did you keep busy?
